# Deeptanium

**Deeptanium** is a solid (drilled tile by tile) ore. Each extraction yields **1.5k** units, and the zone holds it in finite **deposits (nodes)** — when a node is mined below its threshold it is removed and the zone regenerates nodes up to its configured maximum. How the node-generation columns below are used by the server is in [Ore fields](/de/formats/ore-fields/).

## Förderung

| Property | Wert |
|---|---|
| Menge / Förderung | 1.5k |
| Förderungsart | solid (drilled tile by tile) |
| Aktivierungseffekt | nicht erforderlich |
| Geo-Scan-Dokument | definition 8671 |


This ore has no zone node configuration — it is not regenerated in any zone (it exists as a material for production and missions).
